No-code voice-AI platform — drag-and-drop call-flow builder targeted at non-developers. Berlin-based; raised $7.4M Series A Sep-2024 (Singular). Distinguishes itself from Vapi/Retell with visual call-flow builder rather than code-first SDK.

Vonage's AI Studio — visual conversational-agent designer that runs on Vonage CPaaS (SMS / Voice / WhatsApp). Vonage acquired by Ericsson 2022 ($6.2B); AI Studio is the conversational AI layer of the broader CPaaS. Enterprise focus.

Codeium-built agentic IDE (VS Code fork); flagship was Cascade — a planning + execution agent that maintains "Flows" and "Memories" as durable artifacts. Reported acquired by OpenAI in May 2025 for ~$3B (later partly unwound — Google paid ~$2.4B for an inverse-license + key staff; the remaining IDE/IP went to Cognition in July 2025).
cells.funding: Codeium $150M Series C (2024); ~$3B reported OpenAI offer; ultimately $2.4B Google reverse-acqui-hire (2025-07)

cells.desc: Commercial platform built on Ray — distributed training, fine-tuning, serving. Anyscale Endpoints provides hosted OSS inference; ray cluster is the substrate underneath OpenAI's training stack.
cells.funding: $259M total raised through Series C 2021-12 ($99M, Addition led; $1B valuation).

cells.desc: Apollo humanoid maker, spun out of University of Texas Human Centered Robotics Lab. Raised $350M Series A (Feb-2025; B Capital + Capital Factory); Mercedes-Benz manufacturing partner (Mar 2024). Partnered with Google DeepMind on Gemini Robotics (Mar 2025) — Apollo is the headline reference platform for Gemini Robotics.
cells.funding: $350M Series A Feb-2025 (B Capital + Capital Factory)

cells.desc: Open-source data-quality platform for LLM training data — human-in-the-loop labelling, RLHF data collection, dataset curation. Acquired by Hugging Face 2024.
cells.funding: Acquired by Hugging Face in 2024-06; previously seed-funded (~$2M, 2022).

cells.desc: Production ML monitoring + LLM observability (Arize AX) — drift, eval, root-cause. Pre-LLM observability leader; now LLM-pivoted.
cells.funding: $130.7M total raised through Series C 2024-07 ($70M, Salesforce Ventures + Battery led).

cells.desc: Arize AI's open-source LLM observability tool — OpenTelemetry-native LLM tracing, evals, datasets. Arize commercial offers Phoenix + Surveyor.
AWS's managed ML platform — Studio, Training, HyperPod (large-scale clusters), Endpoints. Industry-standard for enterprise AWS-hosted training.
Open-source LLM fine-tuning library — single YAML config drives full / LoRA / QLoRA / DPO training across most popular base models.
cells.funding: Axolotl AI raised pre-seed / undisclosed; primarily OSS-led by Wing Lian; Apache-2.0.

cells.desc: Microsoft Azure's managed ML platform — pipelines, AutoML, Designer, prompt flow (LLM). Heavy integration with Azure OpenAI and Azure AI Studio.
Inference platform for ML models — Truss package format, Chains for multi-model workflows, autoscaling GPU/CPU serving. Targeted at production teams shipping LLM/diffusion endpoints.
cells.funding: $135M total raised through Series C 2024-12 ($75M, IVP led; $825M valuation).

cells.desc: Open model that generates instruction-tuning data conditioned on unstructured text — adapts pretrained LLMs to specialised tasks without manual labels (Brown Univ).
Eval-first LLM platform — datasets, eval runs, prompt playground, tracing. Founded by ex-Impira (acquired by Dropbox) team. Used by Notion, Brex, AirOps.
Distributed PPO/IMPALA reference implementations from CleanRL author — research-friendly, reproducible.
Open-source ML experiment tracking, orchestration, and data management. Allegro AI commercial; widely used in research labs.
cells.funding: $30M total raised through Series A 2022 (Atreides Mgmt led); rebranded Allegro AI -> ClearML.

cells.desc: Founded 2022 by Brad Porter (ex-Amazon Robotics VP + Scale AI CTO). Stealthier than the humanoid pack; raised $100M Series B Apr-2024 (General Catalyst). Targets warehouse + healthcare collaborative robots.
cells.funding: $140M total — including $100M Series B Apr-2024 (General Catalyst)

cells.desc: HPC-AI Tech's distributed training framework — ZeRO + tensor/pipeline parallel + heterogeneous training (CPU offload). HPC-AI raised $50M.
ML experiment tracking + LLM evaluation platform (Opik for LLM eval). Comet competes head-to-head with Weights & Biases.
cells.funding: $108M total raised through Series B 2022-01 ($63M, OpenView led).

cells.desc: Open-source training library from MosaicML (Databricks) — Trainer + recipes for fast convergence; underlies the MPT model training stack.
cells.funding: MosaicML acquired by Databricks for $1.3B in 2023-07; Composer remains Apache-2 OSS.

cells.desc: Open-source DeepEval framework + Confident AI cloud — pytest-style eval runs, hallucination/relevance/bias metrics, datasets.
cells.funding: Confident AI raised seed 2024 (YC S24); commercial steward of DeepEval OSS.

cells.desc: Pieter Abbeel / Peter Chen-founded robotics FM company — built RFM-1 (Robotics Foundation Model, Mar 2024) for warehouse pick-and-place. Acqui-hired by Amazon Aug-2024 (founders + 25% of team to Amazon Robotics); Covariant remains operating as licensee. The first major robotics-FM acquisition.
cells.funding: $222M total raised — $80M Series C 2021 (Index + Radical); Amazon acqui-hire 2024 reported $1.5B-equivalent licensing-fee

cells.desc: Data orchestrator with first-class ML pipeline support — software-defined assets model; competes with Airflow/Prefect for ML pipelines.
cells.funding: $47M total raised through Series B 2022-05 ($33M, Sapphire Ventures led).

cells.desc: Microsoft's distributed-training library — ZeRO optimizer states/grads/params partitioning; ZeRO-Inference for serving. Foundation under many OSS LLM training stacks.
Argilla's framework for synthetic data generation — pipelines of LLM steps that produce SFT/DPO training data; integrates with Hub.
Stanford method that converts RLHF into a supervised-learning loss over preference pairs — no separate reward model needed; widely adopted alignment recipe.
Open-source data and ML model version control — git-like commands for datasets/models stored in cloud blob storage. Foundational tool in MLOps stack.
cells.funding: Iterative.ai raised $20M Series A 2022 (True Ventures led); also runs CML, MLEM, Studio.

cells.desc: Figure AI — humanoid robot maker founded 2022 by Brett Adcock (ex-Archer Aviation). Figure 02 (Aug 2024) + Helix VLA model (Feb 2025) for full-body / hand control. Raised $675M Series B Feb-2024 (Microsoft / OpenAI / Bezos / Intel; $2.6B val); reported new round at $39.5B val Q2 2025. Partnered with BMW for manufacturing pilots.
cells.funding: $675M Series B Feb-2024 (Microsoft, OpenAI, Bezos, NVIDIA, Intel, LG Innotek; $2.6B val); reported $39.5B val funding Q2 2025
cells.api-surface: No public API; closed humanoid platform

cells.desc: Fast inference platform for OSS LLMs — custom Cuda kernels, speculative decoding, multi-LoRA serving. Targets latency-sensitive production use cases.
cells.funding: $77M total raised through Series B 2024-07 ($52M, Sequoia led; $552M valuation).

cells.desc: Kubernetes-native workflow engine — type-safe Python tasks; Lyft origin; Union AI commercial. Strong adoption in regulated industries.
cells.funding: Union.ai (commercial Flyte) raised $19.1M Series A 2022 (NEA led); commercial steward of Flyte OSS.

cells.desc: Native PyTorch fully-sharded data parallel implementation — Meta's response to DeepSpeed ZeRO; FSDP2 in 2024 with improved API.
Galileo Evaluate / Observe / Protect — eval, tracing, guardrails. Big focus on hallucination detection and ChainPoll evaluator metric.
cells.funding: $87.6M total raised through Series B 2024-06 ($45M, Scale Venture Partners led).

cells.desc: Google DeepMind's Gemini Robotics + Gemini Robotics-ER (Embodied Reasoning) released Mar-2025. VLA models built on Gemini 2.0 backbone. Reference platform: Apptronik Apollo. The DeepMind line of robotics-FM, descendant of earlier RT-1 / RT-2 / RT-X work.
cells.deployment: Trusted-tester via partners; Vertex AI / Cloud planned
cells.api-surface: Vertex AI / Google Cloud Robotics endpoint planned

cells.desc: Google Cloud's managed training service — TPU and GPU clusters, hyperparameter tuning, model registry. Part of Vertex AI umbrella.
DeepSeek-Math's GRPO — group-relative advantage estimation replacing PPO's critic. Used in DeepSeek-R1 reasoning post-training; widely adopted in OSS reasoning RLHF.
Open-source LLM observability with one-line proxy integration — gateway routes through their proxy, captures every LLM call. Sessions + custom properties + evals.
Library for accessing and processing 100k+ public datasets on the Hub. Apache Arrow-backed; default dataset layer for the open ML ecosystem.

Hugging Face's open-source robotics platform — datasets, baselines, training code for imitation learning + diffusion policy + ACT. Launched May 2024; growing rapidly with community contributions (HopeJR, SO-100 arms). LeRobot is the de-facto OSS robotics-ML platform analogous to transformers.
cells.deployment: Pip install; runs anywhere PyTorch runs
cells.pricing: OSS free; HF Hub free + paid tiers
cells.funding: Hugging Face parent — $235M Series D 2023 ($4.5B val)
cells.api-surface: Python; HF Hub for datasets + models

cells.desc: Collaborative LLM development platform — non-eng prompt editor, eval, tracing. UK; Index Ventures + Y Combinator backed.
Open-source humanoid robot maker — K-Scale OS (Kos), Stompy and KBot humanoids. YC W24. Pitched as the 'open-source humanoid' alternative to Figure / Tesla — full hardware + software OSS.
Open-source data-labelling platform supporting text, image, audio, video, time-series. Commercial Enterprise edition + Cloud (HumanSignal).
cells.funding: HumanSignal raised $25M Series A in 2022-06 (Redpoint Ventures led); Label Studio OSS is Apache-2.0.

cells.desc: Enterprise data-labelling platform — annotation tools + 'Frontier' offering (expert RLHF labelers + Boost compute). Pivoting toward frontier-lab data services.
cells.funding: $188.9M total raised (Series D $110M, 2022-01; led by SoftBank Vision Fund 2).

cells.desc: Git-like branching, commits, and rollback for object-store data lakes (S3/GCS/Azure). Treeverse commercial; OSS + Cloud edition.
cells.funding: Treeverse raised $23M Series A 2022-04 (Dell Technologies Capital led; total ~$31M).

cells.desc: BerriAI's open-source LLM gateway — unified OpenAI-format API for 100+ providers; LiteLLM Proxy adds budgets, fallbacks, observability, rate-limiting.
cells.funding: BerriAI raised $1.6M seed 2023 (Y Combinator W23); commercial steward of LiteLLM OSS.

cells.desc: Unified efficient fine-tuning of 100+ LLMs — SFT, DPO, PPO, KTO, ORPO with LoRA/QLoRA/full; CLI + WebUI. Popular in the Chinese OSS scene.
Microsoft Research's Low-Rank Adapters method — trains rank-r matrices added to attention weights; 10000x parameter reduction. Foundation of all adapter-style fine-tuning.
PyTorch-library form of Megatron-LM — distributed training building blocks (tensor/pipeline/expert parallel) packaged for embedding into custom training stacks.
NVIDIA's reference framework for training large transformer models with tensor, pipeline, sequence, and expert parallelism. Underpins many frontier-lab training stacks.
Databricks-incubated open platform for ML lifecycle — tracking, projects, models, model registry. Standard ML-ops baseline. MLflow 3.0 (2024) added LLM-eval features.
cells.funding: OSS project — sponsored by Databricks (Databricks raised $43.2B at $62B valuation 2024-12, $10B Series J 2024-12).

cells.desc: Serverless cloud for AI/ML — Python-decorator workflow defines GPU/CPU functions deployed to managed infra; widely used for training jobs, batch inference, and agent backends.
cells.funding: $96M total raised through Series A 2024-03 ($80M, Lux + Redpoint led; $1B+ valuation).

cells.desc: NVIDIA's open synthetic-data generation pipelines (HelpSteer2, NemoSkills, Nemotron-4 340B). Used by frontier labs to bootstrap RLHF reward modeling data.

NVIDIA Project GR00T (Mar-2024) — general-purpose humanoid foundation model + Isaac simulation stack + Jetson Thor compute. GR00T N1 model released open March 2025. NVIDIA's full-stack play: model + sim + compute + training cloud (Cosmos). Major partners include Figure, Apptronik, Boston Dynamics, Agility.
cells.deployment: On-robot (Jetson Thor) + simulation (Isaac Sim) + training cloud (Cosmos)
cells.pricing: OSS weights free; Cosmos / Jetson hardware sold separately
cells.funding: NVIDIA parent — public company, $3T+ mkt cap

cells.desc: Inference cloud spun out of OctoML — acquired by NVIDIA in 2024. Originally TVM-compiler heritage; offered API for OSS LLM/diffusion serving.
cells.funding: Acquired by NVIDIA in 2024-10 (terms undisclosed; reportedly ~$250M); previously raised $135M total through Series C 2023-12 (Tiger Global led).

cells.desc: Arize-led open OTel semantic conventions for LLM/agent tracing — auto-instrumentation for OpenAI/Anthropic/LangChain/LlamaIndex etc.
Traceloop's open-source OpenTelemetry auto-instrumentation for LLM workflows — works with any OTel-compatible backend (Datadog, New Relic, Grafana, etc.).

OpenMind — open robot OS (OM1) + FABRIC interconnect, founded by Jan Liphardt (Stanford). Pitched as the 'Android of robots': any humanoid + any LLM + the same OS layer. Raised $20M Series A (Pantera + others, 2025).
Distributed RLHF training framework built on Ray + DeepSpeed + vLLM — supports PPO/DPO/REINFORCE++/GRPO. Targeted at 70B+ models with efficient sample throughput.
Commercial platform behind Metaflow (originally Netflix OSS) — ML workflow orchestration with managed compute, focused on data scientists shipping production pipelines.
cells.funding: $26.6M total raised through Series A 2022 (Index Ventures led); commercial steward of Metaflow OSS.

cells.desc: Data-versioning and pipeline platform — Pachyderm File System tracks lineage across pipeline runs. Acquired by HPE in 2023.
cells.funding: $28.5M raised through Series B (2020-06) before HPE acquired in 2023-01 (terms undisclosed).

cells.desc: Enterprise eval and guardrails platform — Lynx hallucination detector (open weights), Glider judge model, Polyglot benchmark. Built by ex-Meta researchers.
cells.funding: $50M total raised through Series A 2024-10 ($17M Series A + $35M extension; Notable Capital led).

cells.desc: Hugging Face's PEFT library — LoRA, AdaLoRA, IA3, Prefix Tuning, P-Tuning. Standard interface for adapter-style fine-tuning.

Founded 2024 by Sergey Levine (UC Berkeley) and Karol Hausman + others (ex-Google Brain Robotics). Building general-purpose robot foundation models (π0 released Oct-2024; π0.5 in 2025) trained on cross-embodiment robot trajectories. Raised $400M Series A (Nov-2024; Jeff Bezos, OpenAI, Thrive, Lux) at $2.4B val.
cells.deployment: OSS weights (OpenPI) self-host on robot hardware; no first-party commercial endpoint as of 2025-04 — partners deploy in-house
cells.funding: $400M Series A Nov-2024 (Bezos / OpenAI / Thrive / Lux; $2.4B val)
cells.api-surface: Python; checkpoints on HF; robot hardware integration via repo

cells.desc: MIT spinout focused on truck-unloading robots — autonomously empties truck trailers. Raised $50M Series B (Mar 2024, Tiger Global + others). Narrow focus but production deployments at major logistics customers.
AI gateway + observability — load balancing across 200+ LLMs, retries, caching, eval, prompts. Open-source Gateway + commercial Portkey Cloud.
cells.funding: $3M seed 2024 (Lightspeed India + Y Combinator); OSS + Cloud gateway/observability.

cells.desc: Python-native workflow orchestrator — widely used for ML pipelines and ETL. Prefect Cloud + open-source Prefect Core.
cells.funding: $92.6M total raised through Series B 2022-03 ($32M, Tiger Global led; total $42M including earlier rounds).

cells.desc: Prompt versioning + tracing platform — non-eng-friendly prompt editor; early entrant pre-LLM-ops wave.
4-bit quantized LoRA fine-tuning — train 65B models on a single 48GB GPU. UW (Tim Dettmers).
Open-source eval framework for RAG pipelines — faithfulness, answer-relevance, context-precision, context-recall. Widely used as a baseline RAG eval kit.
Ray's distributed training library — multi-node PyTorch/TF jobs; integrates Ray Tune and Ray Serve. Used at scale by OpenAI/Uber/Anyscale.
Hosted-API platform for OSS models — Cog format packages models with their environment; thousands of community models behind a single REST API.
cells.funding: $57M total raised through Series B 2024-02 ($40M, a16z led; $350M valuation).

cells.desc: Allen AI's research library for RL training of language models — NLPO algorithm, NLP-task RL benchmarks; predates the TRL/OpenRLHF surge.
Research codebase for RLHF reward modelling — pairwise / Bradley-Terry / pointwise reward heads; release of RewardBench-winning models.
End-to-end computer-vision platform — dataset hosting, annotation, training, deployment. Universe public-dataset library; widely used for production CV.
cells.funding: $60M raised: $20M Series A 2022, $40M Series B 2024-04 (Two Sigma Ventures led).

cells.desc: ETH RSL's lightweight PyTorch RL library — optimised for GPU rollouts in robotics simulation (Isaac/MuJoCo). Used in many legged-robot RL papers.
GPU-cloud platform — Pods (long-running), Serverless (per-request), and Hub (community templates). Popular for fine-tuning and inference of OSS models.
cells.funding: $20M Series A 2024-05 (Intel Capital, Dell Technologies Capital led).

cells.desc: Vancouver-based humanoid maker; Phoenix robot powered by Carbon cognitive architecture. Founded 2018 by Geordie Rose (ex-D-Wave + Kindred). Less well-funded than Figure / 1X / Apptronik but with a distinctive cognitive-architecture (atomic-action-based) approach.
Data-labeling powerhouse for AI training — RLHF data, fine-tuning corpora, frontier-lab partnerships. Meta invested $14B in Scale in 2025 for a 49% stake; Wang joined Meta as Chief AI Officer.
cells.funding: $1.4B raised across rounds incl. $14B Meta strategic investment in 2024-06 (Meta took ~49% stake; Wang joined Meta Superintelligence Labs).

cells.desc: Fast LLM serving framework with RadixAttention (cache reuse across requests with shared prefixes) + structured programming primitives. UC Berkeley.
Programmatic data labelling and weak supervision platform — built on Snorkel research from Stanford. Enterprise platform for high-volume data programming.
cells.funding: $135M total raised through Series C 2021-08 ($85M, Addition led; $1B valuation).

cells.desc: PyTorch implementations of RL algorithms (PPO, SAC, DQN, etc.) — research-grade reliability; widely used as a reference benchmark.
Premium human-labelling company specialised in RLHF data and difficult expert tasks — Surge prides itself on bootstrapped, no-VC; major frontier-lab supplier.
cells.funding: Bootstrapped (no disclosed external funding) — reportedly profitable from inception.

cells.desc: NVIDIA's TensorRT extension for LLM inference — compiles transformers to optimised kernels for Hopper/Blackwell. Used in NIM and downstream deployments.
Hugging Face's production inference server for LLMs — continuous batching, FlashAttention, quantization (bitsandbytes, GPTQ).
Cloud platform for OSS LLM inference and fine-tuning — serverless inference, dedicated endpoints, fine-tuning API, training cluster.
cells.funding: $228.5M total raised through Series A 2024-03 ($106M, Salesforce Ventures led; $1.25B valuation); Series B 2024-11 reportedly $200M+ at $3.3B.

cells.desc: Pure-PyTorch library for fine-tuning LLMs — Llama/Mistral/Phi/Gemma recipes; native FSDP2 + memory-efficient training. From Meta PyTorch team.

Toyota Research Institute's robotics group — published Large Behavior Models (LBMs) Sep-2023 + diffusion-policy / behavior-cloning at scale. Industrial-research lab with Toyota's manufacturing-data advantage. Not a startup — division of Toyota Motor Corp.
cells.deployment: Research-stage; Toyota internal pilots; OSS code for community
cells.funding: Toyota Motor Corp internal research arm; $1B+ initial endowment (2015)

cells.desc: Hugging Face's open-source library for fine-tuning and aligning transformer models with RLHF, DPO, ORPO, KTO and PPO trainers. The default RLHF stack on top of HF Transformers.
ML observability with the TruLens open-source LLM eval framework — the 'RAG Triad' (context-relevance, groundedness, answer-relevance) metrics. Acquired by Snowflake 2024-05.
cells.funding: Acquired by Snowflake in 2024-05 (terms undisclosed); previously raised $42M total through Series B 2022.

cells.desc: Open-source LLM/RAG evaluation framework — feedback functions, the RAG Triad. Originally TruEra; now Snowflake-stewarded.
Fast and memory-efficient LLM fine-tuning library — claims 2-5× speedup, 60-80% memory savings on a single GPU vs HF baseline through custom Triton kernels.
cells.funding: $0 disclosed external funding; bootstrapped (operated by Daniel & Michael Han); Y Combinator S24.

cells.desc: End-to-end LLM development platform — eval, prompt management, deployment, observability. Targeted at enterprise teams shipping LLM products.
cells.funding: $5M seed 2023 (Y Combinator S23 + Rebel Fund + Eastlink).

cells.desc: ByteDance Volcano-Engine's open RLHF framework — flexible HybridFlow architecture; supports PPO/GRPO at large scale.
Experiment-tracking and ML-ops platform — log metrics, artifacts, datasets, sweeps. Acquired by CoreWeave in 2025 for $1.7B.
cells.funding: $250M total raised through Series C (2023-03, valuation reported ~$1.25B unicorn) — Insight Partners led.

cells.desc: Open-source ML pipeline orchestration framework — connects sklearn/PyTorch/HF pipelines to MLflow/W&B/cloud infra. Pivoting toward LLM-ops.
cells.funding: $6.4M seed 2022 (Point Nine Capital, La Famiglia); commercial ZenML Pro.
